# @epure/dev

> The épure dev server, bin `epure-dev`: `rescript watch`, `radif dev` and
> vite, three processes as one. A scaffolded project devDepends on it and
> runs it as `pnpm dev`; `epure-dev prepare` runs at install and writes the
> desk entry in `.mcp.json`. There is no importable API — the package is
> its bin.

## Exact contracts

These files are authoritative. If prose differs, follow them.

- The bin: `./bin/epure-dev.mjs`, its logic in `./src/Dev.res`.
- The ports and the `/_radif/` proxy live in the project's own
  `vite.config.mjs`, not here. Dev only starts, watches and stops.

## Key facts

- Run `pnpm dev` in the background and leave it running. It is a
  long-running process; never wait for it to exit.
- Once the app answers, dev prints one clickable line — the project's
  name, two spaces, `http://localhost:8080/?radif-session=<token>`. Give
  that link to the person: the app opens only on a session. The app keeps
  the token in `localStorage` and strips it from the address.
- The app is on port 8080 only (`strictPort`), host `127.0.0.1`. radif is
  on 8081 behind vite's `/_radif/` proxy, so no app route may take
  `/_radif/`. Vite starts only after radif has said `dev`, so the store is
  served before the app can answer.
- Dev writes the `desk` entry of the project's `.mcp.json` on every
  serve: url `http://localhost:8080/_radif/mcp`, the session in the
  `Authorization` header. Other entries in the file are kept; a file that
  does not parse is left with a warning. The file is owner-only and
  gitignored — an agent reads it to reach the desk, and the desk answers
  only while dev runs.
- `epure-dev prepare` is the template's `postinstall`: it boots `radif dev`
  once on an ephemeral port, founds the `.data` store if it is new,
  writes `.mcp.json`, and stops. When radif is missing, dies early, or
  says nothing — most often because a running `pnpm dev` holds `.data` —
  it warns and exits zero: the install stays whole, and the running dev
  maintains the file itself.
- A wiped `.data` heals on the next serve, with a new session in
  `.mcp.json`. An agent holding a stale token must be restarted so its
  MCP client re-reads the file.
- One child dying takes dev down, and dev exits nonzero after every child
  has closed. A missing radif is named with its cure: install
  `@radif/server`, or set `EPURE_RADIF_BIN` to a checkout's
  `server/bin/radif.mjs`.
- The desk writes the app's generated model into `src/domain/api/entity`
  through `radif dev --types`. Nobody runs a types command by hand, and
  nobody edits the generated files.
- `rescript` and `vite` are peer dependencies at `*`: dev runs the
  project's own bins and pulls nothing. `epure-dev` needs the project
  installed; the scaffolder is `create-epure`, bin `epure`, and only
  scaffolds.

## Around it

- The method and the working agreement: the project's `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- The database the store serves: `node_modules/@radif/db/llms.txt`.
- The wire and the desk: `node_modules/@radif/server/llms.txt`.
